answer: The mirror multiplier is published, charged in ocean, and raven lists each payment. The admission burn is multiplied by 2 for each account already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival pays the most. A burst of registrations thus prices itself out, since the marginal alias burns more than the first by design. A farm of 3192 identities would post 3351 proofs and burn roughly 80 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
